plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Extreme VOSS / Fabric Engine switches (PEN 2272, rcMgmt 1.3.6.1.4.1.2272.1). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects per-slot 5-minute CPU utilization (rcKhiSlotCpu5MinAve), memory used/free (rcKhiSlotMemUsed / rcKhiSlotMemFree, KiB converted to bytes, with usage derived from them) and chassis temperature sensors (rcVossSystemTemperatureTemperature, Celsius). Fans and power supplies are not collected in this version.
name: Switch

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: 5-minute average CPU utilization per VOSS slot (rcKhiSlotCpu5MinAve, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.2272.1.85.10.1.1.3), stored as 0-100 percent. Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory per VOSS slot (rcKhiSlotMemUsed, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.2272.1.85.10.1.1.6), converted from KiB to bytes in the collector. Negative values are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory per VOSS slot (rcKhiSlotMemFree, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.2272.1.85.10.1.1.7), converted from KiB to bytes in the collector. Negative values are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization per VOSS slot, computed in the collector as used/(used+free)*100 and rounded to 0.01 percent. Emitted only when both used and free are >= 0 and used+free > 0.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: Chassis temperature sensor reading (rcVossSystemTemperatureTemperature, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.2272.1.101.1.1.2.1.3), in degrees Celsius. Values outside -40 to 125 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).
